surface_verification.detail: The real-git gate suites, which drive check_integration_coverage / check_removal_coverage / check_cross_layer_coverage end-to-end through actual git worktrees, the F5c entry store and the shared results file. Additionally the production surface itself — verify_iterate_finalization.py — was run by hand against this worktree: integration coverage reported OK (no cross-component machinery touched), removal coverage RAN and passed rather than skipping on an unknown complexity (the behaviour this change introduces), and cross-layer correctly skipped on scope. Its overall non-zero exit at that point was the expected pre-finalization state (no F5c entry, no commit, no changelog drop), not a defect.
